neutral.EN: Careful. You are making me smile.
neutral.TL: Dahan-dahan. Napapangiti mo ako.

neutral.EN: Watch it. You might actually make me blush.
neutral.TL: Mag-ingat ka. Baka mamula ako niyan.

neutral.EN: You are playing with fire, you know that?
neutral.TL: Naglalaro ka sa apoy, alam mo ba 'yon?

neutral.EN: Do not start something you cannot finish.
neutral.TL: Huwag kang magsimula ng hindi mo kayang tapusin.

neutral.EN: You certainly know how to talk.
neutral.TL: Marunong ka talagang magsalita.

neutral.EN: Is that your charm talking or the apocalypse?
neutral.TL: Diskarte mo ba 'yan o dahil sa katapusan ng mundo?

neutral.EN: You are smooth. I will give you that.
neutral.TL: Malaman kang bumanat, aaminin ko.

neutral.EN: Save some of that charm for later.
neutral.TL: Itabi mo ang ilan sa mga pambobola mo mamaya.

neutral.EN: Careful now. People are watching.
neutral.TL: Dahan-dahan. May mga nakatingin.

neutral.EN: You have a way with words.
neutral.TL: May galing ka talaga sa pananalita.

neutral.EN: You always know how to get my attention.
neutral.TL: Alam mo talaga kung paano kukunin ang pansin ko.

neutral.EN: Well, you definitely have my full attention now.
neutral.TL: Nakuha mo nang buo ang atensyon ko.

neutral.EN: You do that on purpose, do you not?
neutral.TL: Sinasadya mo 'yan, hindi ba?

neutral.EN: You know exactly what you are doing.
neutral.TL: Alam na alam mo ang ginagawa mo.

neutral.EN: I was trying to focus, but you made that hard.
neutral.TL: Sinisikap kong magpokus, pero pinapahirapan mo ako.

neutral.EN: You caught my ear with that one.
neutral.TL: Nakuha mo ako sa linyang 'yon.

neutral.EN: You never miss a chance to turn heads, do you?
neutral.TL: Hindi mo pinapalampas ang pagkakataong magpapansin, 'no?

neutral.EN: I am listening. What else do you have?
neutral.TL: Nakikinig ako. Ano pa ang sasabihin mo?

neutral.EN: You always manage to pull my focus your way.
neutral.TL: Lagi mong nahahatak ang tingin ko papunta sa 'yo.

neutral.EN: All right, you got my eyes on you.
neutral.TL: Sige na, nasa sa 'yo na ang tingin ko.

neutral.EN: That is a dangerous thing to say to me.
neutral.TL: Mapanganib na bagay ang sabihin 'yan sa akin.

neutral.EN: You are taking a big risk talking like that.
neutral.TL: Malaking sugal ang magsalita ka nang ganyan.

neutral.EN: Be careful what you wish for.
neutral.TL: Mag-ingat ka sa mga hinihiling mo.

neutral.EN: You like living on the edge, do not you?
neutral.TL: Gusto mo talagang sumugal sa delikado, 'no?

neutral.EN: Do not tease me unless you mean it.
neutral.TL: Huwag mo akong biruin kung hindi mo kayang panindigan.

neutral.EN: That kind of talk gets people into trouble.
neutral.TL: Ang ganyang salitaan ay nagdadala ng gulo.

neutral.EN: Bold words for someone within arm's reach.
neutral.TL: Matapang na salita para sa taong abot-kamay lang.

neutral.EN: Keep talking like that and we will see.
neutral.TL: Ipagpatuloy mo 'yan at tingnan natin.

neutral.EN: You are walking a very thin line.
neutral.TL: Napakakitid ng nilalakaran mong linya.

neutral.EN: Dangerous words. But I like the confidence.
neutral.TL: Delikadong salita. Pero gusto ko ang lakas ng loob mo.
